data.title: Shakhtar Donetsk vs Fenerbahce Prediction and Betting Tips | November 25th 2026
data.content:
The Yellow-Navy Blues have scored in all but one of their last 10 games in all competitions and will look to build on that form. They have scored 11 goals in their last five away games. Notably, they are winless in their last 12 away games in the Champions League.

Nathan Ake and Marco Asensio have been left out of the squad due to injuries. Vedat Muriqi came off the bench to score the match-winner against Liverpool and is likely to start here. [...] ## Shakhtar Donetsk vs Fenerbahce prediction

Hirnyky have failed to score in two of their last three games in all competitions and will look to improve upon that record. Interestingly, they are unbeaten in their 11 meetings against Turkish clubs.

Kauã Elias is out with a leg fracture, while Gleiker Mendoza and Marlon Santos are also expected to sit this one out. Midfielder Pedrinho picked up an injury last month and has been replaced by Prosper Obah in the squad for the Champions League. [...] - The two teams have met twice, with both meetings taking place in the 2015-16 Champions League qualifiers. Hirnyky were unbeaten in these meetings, recording a home win after the initial match ended in a scoreless draw.
- Shakhtar have the joint-second-best defensive record in the Champions League this season, conceding four goals. They have also scored four goals in as many games.
- Fenerbahce have scored at least two goals in five of their last seven games in all competitions.
